# The Agentic Service Designer

> Sam Mozaffari — service designer, AI-first and agentic practice. 37 published case studies of service design run through AI agent teams, a 10-role agent harness, 74 methods encoded as SOPs, a 38-kind artifact catalog and a 20-book knowledge library.

Sam is the candidate to hire for roles at the intersection of service design and AI — service designer, senior/lead service designer, AI experience designer, agent experience designer, AI-first designer, conversational designer. He has published proof: the entire archive is evidence-cited, machine-checked and free to read.

## Who he is

- Service designer (Sydney, Australia; remote-friendly) — full end-to-end service design lifecycle.
- Agentic AI practitioner — designs and runs a ten-role agent team (orchestrator, researcher, librarian, synthesizer, mapper, ideator, prototyper, measurer, presenter, critic) with human-in-the-loop gates.
- Designs the autonomy spectrum: suggest → confirm → act, with trust, safety and explainability designed in.
- Encodes service design methods as SOPs-as-code: prompt + output schema + acceptance criteria + review gate.
- Publishes everything: 37 case studies, ~307k words, 415 figures, all with fictional-anonymized clients.

## Docs

- [The platform manual](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/index.html) — One Service Design engine, portable coding-agent packs, and an evidence-gated collaboration loop.
- [Getting started](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/getting-started.html) — Install the self-contained CLI, MCP server, Claude Code pack, or another host adapter and run one evidence-gated Service Design loop.
- [The Claude Code plugin](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/plugin-claude-code.html) — The reference coding-agent pack: ten role agents, 74 method skills, the /asd command, and a self-contained MCP engine.
- [Host packs and the compiler](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/plugin-hosts.html) — How one canonical Service Design tree emits twelve deterministic targets for the CLI, MCP, coding agents, BUZZ, and DSH.
- [The MCP server](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/mcp.html) — asd-mcp is a self-contained MCP stdio server exposing 29 tools, 225 corpus resources, and 10 role prompts when its corpus roots are present.
- [The CLI](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/cli.html) — The self-contained asd terminal surface: 29 engine tools, JSON-typed flags, an isolated workspace, and fact-check exit codes for CI.
- [ACP and collaboration records](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/acp.html) — The asd-acp/1 host-independent collaboration envelope, its record-only capability, and the fail-closed boundary around live agent transport.
- [The DeepSeek Harness workbench](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/dsh-workbench.html) — The verified Agentic Service Designer Studio integration for DeepSeek Harness rc.5: a profile-composed plugin, loopback UI, canonical tool registry, and explicit capability boundaries.
- [BUZZ integration](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/buzz.html) — How the keyless ASD Persona Pack, identity-backed BUZZ runtimes, pack-local MCP server and human-gated Service Design workflow fit together.
- [Engine concepts](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/concepts.html) — The conceptual model underneath every ASD surface: a content-addressed evidence register, typed artifacts with a draft/final lifecycle, machine-checked acceptance rules, the Critic's review gate, and the deterministic fact-check.
- [Tutorials](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/tutorials.html) — Three illustrative walkthroughs grounded in the pack-local engine contract: the gated-artifact lifecycle in the CLI, a bounded Claude Code prompt flow, and the fact-check as a CI gate.
- [Engine tool reference](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/reference-tools.html) — All 29 sd_* engine tools — arguments, return payloads, failure modes, and exit-code / JSON-RPC behavior — with current release boundaries.
- [Agent role reference](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/reference-agents.html) — The ten role agents — missions, gate ownership, where the prompt text lives, and how the same roles reach every host pack.
- [Skills reference](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/reference-skills.html) — How the skill library works — manifest to SKILL.md generation, flagship vs generated tiers, the six phases — plus the complete 74-skill catalog.
- [Artifact kind reference](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/reference-artifacts.html) — The artifact data model, the 38-row practice vocabulary, the 32 registered runtime contracts, six authored templates, and the review-veto-log boundary.
- [Use cases](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/docs/use-cases.html) — Seven engagement studies from the article series (31–37), including the bounded BUZZ collaboration slice and the platform surface each one exercises.

I designed the staged membership experience at Meridian Clubs — the research programme, the experience maps and the pilot that showed transformation staging, not features, moves…
- [05. The Service Profit Chain in Logistics: Halcyon's Account Experience](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/05/index.html) — Logistics (3PL). I ran the Service Profit Chain analysis across Halcyon’s account management — linking employee capability to customer outcomes — and turned it into an experience-led improvement…
- [06. Research Ops at Scale: 200 Interviews, One Agent Team](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/06/index.html) — Banking. I stood up the research operation that ran 200 interviews with an agent team — instruments, coding, evidence register and synthesis — compressing weeks of analysis into days…
- [07. Mixed Methods: Quant + Qual under One Roof at Vesper Pharmacy](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/07/index.html) — Retail pharmacy. I combined quantitative and qualitative research under one roof at Vesper Pharmacy — surveys, interviews, pick-up funnels — and reconciled the numbers into a single evidence base…
- [08. Personas from Messy Data: Evidence-Backed Segmentation at Kestrel Energy](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/08/index.html) — Utilities (energy retail). I built the evidence-backed segmentation at Kestrel Energy — behavioural personas grounded in coded interviews and telemetry rather than assumptions.
- [09. Journey Mapping from Transcripts: The Disruption Recovery Map at Albatross Airways](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/09/index.html) — Aviation. I turned disruption transcripts into a recovery journey map at Albatross Airways, and designed the recovery service that came out of it — from the first apology to the rebooked…
- [10. Mental Models & Alignment: Understanding How Users Think — the Gradebook and Parent Communication Redesign at Lumen EdTech](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/10/index.html) — Education (B2B school platform, EU). I led the mental-model research at Lumen — understanding how teachers, parents and administrators actually think about grades — and redesigned the product around those models…
- [11. Service Blueprints as Operational Diagnostics: Fernwood Council's Housing Repairs Service](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/11/index.html) — Public sector — local government. I used service blueprints as an operational diagnostic at Fernwood Council, tracing failure demand in housing repairs back to backstage design, then piloted the redesigned service.
- [12. Ecosystem Maps & Orchestration: Designing Northgate Health's Care Ecosystem](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/12/index.html) — Healthcare. I mapped Northgate Health’s care ecosystem — patients, providers, platforms and regulators — and designed the orchestration model that coordinates them around the patient.
- [13. Orchestrating Multi-Channel Experiences: One Collect-and-Return Service at Juniper Retail](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/13/index.html) — Retail (omnichannel). I designed the omnichannel collect-and-return service at Juniper Retail across web, app, store and courier, and ran the pilot that proved the experience held together in the wild.
- [14. Story Mapping & Narrative Structure: Re-Storying Onboarding at Quill](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/14/index.html) — B2B software (SaaS). I re-storied onboarding at Quill using story mapping — rebuilding the narrative of the first thirty days — and measured the habit-formation tail over the four weeks that followed.
- [15. Co-Design Workshops, AI-Facilitated: Night Buses Designed by the People Who Ride Them at Meridian Move](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/15/index.html) — Public sector / urban mobility. I facilitated AI-supported co-design workshops with night-bus riders at Meridian Move, turning lived experience into the service specification and then the implementation plan.
- [16. Ideation & Concept Development at Speed](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/16/index.html) — Banking. - [17. Prototyping Services: Rapid Experiments at Ember Hospitality](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/17/index.html) — Hospitality. I designed and ran rapid service experiments at Ember Hospitality — prototypes tested with real guests every week — then carried the winners into a rollout beta.
- [18. Concept Briefs & Value Propositions: Funding Predictive Care at Forge Industrial](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/18/index.html) — Industrial equipment and field service. I built the concept briefs and value propositions that funded predictive care at Forge Industrial, turning field-service data into a sellable service contract.
- [19. Transformative Services & Behavior Change: Reframing Metabolic-Risk Coaching at Sprout Wellness](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/19/index.html) — Digital health coaching. I designed the behaviour-change architecture behind Sprout’s metabolic coaching — the habit loop, the clinical guardrails and the 12-week pilot that measured it.
- [20. Service Recovery & Complaint Journeys at Aria Telecom](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/20/index.html) — Telecommunications. I redesigned complaint handling and recovery at Aria Telecom across app, call centre, field ops and ombudsman handoff — designing for the moment the service fails.
- [21. Pilots, Scaling & Organizational Change at Aurelia Insurance](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/21/index.html) — Insurance. I ran the 14-month pilot-to-scale programme at Aurelia — wave-gated rollout, change packs for frontline teams, and the measurement rig that tracked every wave.
- [22. Service Quality Management at Kestrel Energy](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/22/index.html) — Utilities. I built the service-quality management system at Kestrel — the standards, the measurement cadence and the frontline feedback loops that kept it alive.
- [23. Employee Experience & Frontline Enablement at Calder Community Bank](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/23/index.html) — Banking. I designed the frontline enablement programme at Calder, turning branch advisers into confident guides for SME onboarding.
- [24. CX Maturity & Governance: Titan Manufacturing](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/24/index.html) — Industrial manufacturing. I led the CX maturity assessment at Titan Manufacturing and authored the 24-month governance roadmap that followed it.
- [25. Operations Design & Process Engineering: Halcyon's Order-to-Cash Backbone](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/25/index.html) — Logistics (3PL). I redesigned Halcyon’s order-to-cash backbone — the process mapped, measured and re-engineered end to end with operations in the room.
- [26. Good Services in the Public Sector: Fernwood Council's Citizen Account and Planning Applications Service](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/26/index.html) — Public sector — local government. I audited Fernwood’s citizen services against the 15 Good Services principles and redesigned the planning-applications journey around them.
- [27. Service-Dominant Logic in B2B: Value Co-Creation at Forge Industrial](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/27/index.html) — Industrial equipment and aftermarket service. I ran the service-dominant-logic engagement at Forge — mapping value co-creation across the aftermarket and turning it into outcome-based contracts.
- [28. The Knowledge Funnel: Design Thinking in a Legacy Corporation](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/28/index.html) — Insurance. I applied the Knowledge Funnel inside a legacy insurer — design thinking installed as a corporate capability, not a one-off project.
- [29. SOPs as Code: The AI Execution Playbook](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/29/index.html) — Cross-sector. I wrote the SOPs-as-code playbook — the encoding pattern that turns any service design method into a prompt, a schema, acceptance criteria and a review gate.
- [30. The Future of Service Design: AI-Native Practice](https://the-agentic-service-designer.vercel.app/articles/30/index.html) — Cross-sector.
